description:
Links your anonymous purchase to the authenticated account, without a new charge.
Requires a session and private proof of the purchase. It records the global right of the account by the payment receipt: idempotent for the same owner, and another owner cannot claim it. The code keeps opening the document by itself.

acesso_codigo.description: Private capability received after the payment. The document cookie is also accepted.

id.description: Positive ID of the purchased document.
